text:
Loren: Quick design review — throwing up the filter/compare mock from this morning. main things i want eyes on: filter grouping behavior (chips vs nested list), badge contrast for performance/latency, and version pinning semantics when you compare models. screenshot: https://redwood.app/snap/xyz :camera:

Maya: Nicely compact. two quick a11y nits: the perf badge green doesn't meet contrast at small sizes, and the thin divider between filter groups is hard to see in low light. can we bump the badge background or add a 1px outline? :thinking:

Ashok: From infra side — compare table is already pretty tight on row height; if we add outlines on badges we should avoid increasing row height. also: on pinning, what's the intended persistence? local-only (client) or tied to user account (backend)? affects implementation complexity + rollout.

Sam: For chips: +1 to grouping similar filters under an accordion. Proposal: show top 3 active chips, then a "+N" collapsed chip that expands inline (no modal). on expand, keep keyboard focus and allow arrows to traverse. small animation for expand/collapse. I can mock the microinteraction. :sparkles:

DesignBot: Accessibility checklist: 
- Perf badge color contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text on bg (WCAG AA).
- badges should include aria-labels, e.g. `aria-label="latency: 120ms, 95th percentile"`.
- pin action must be keyboard reachable and expose `aria-pressed` state.
(see: /a11y/checklist)

Maya: Copy thoughts for pin tooltip: current tooltip: "Pin version — keep this compare view". Suggestion: "Pin version to this compare view. Persists until unpinned." shorter alt: "Pinned: this version will stay in compare". also we should show a subtle snackbar with "Unpinned" undo after you unpin.

Loren: Good call on snackbar. UX question: when you pin a version in a multi-compare, should it stay pinned when switching models in the left column? My instinct: yes — pin is semantic, not view-scoped. but we need a visual affordance that clarifies scope (e.g., a small label "pinned to compare" visible on the model card).

Ashok: Engineering recommendation: default to client-side persistence (localStorage) for immediate rollout, with a backend opt-in for enterprise customers who want cross-device persistence. we'll add a `pinnedVersions` field on the user settings API later. Quick caveat: localStorage can be cleared; doc that behavior.

Sam: animation idea for pin: small scale + star -> then badge fades in from top-right. keeps motion subtle so it doesn't push layout. i can prototype 150ms ease-in.

Maya: Also: performance badges — add an icon (clock/lightning) left of the numeric to help color-blind users. and allow text-only mode in condensed rows (icon + number vs color band).

Loren: On filter grouping: prefer inline collapse rather than nested modal. keeps discovery high. we should show counts for each group and allow multi-select with shift/ctrl. Also consider a compact mode toggle in settings to increase density for power users.

Ashok: About URL state: if we persist pins in backend for enterprise, we should also reflect pins in the compare URL (query param) so customers can share a compare link that includes pins/filters. that will help reproducibility for evals.

DesignBot: Quick aria snip for pin button: ```html
<button aria-pressed=\"false\" aria-label=\"Pin version v1.2.3 to compare\">⭐</button>
```

Maya: tiny copy tweak for the filter collapsed chip: change "+3 more" -> "+3 filters" (clearer), and hover text "Show 3 more filters".

Loren: Love it. next steps: Sam, can you prototype the expand animation + keyboard flow? Maya, can you update the figma with the accessibility changes and new microcopy? Ashok, would appreciate a short PR sketch for storage approach (localStorage + opt-in backend) so we can sync with infra. i'll schedule a 30m handoff tomorrow.

Sam: Yep — will drop a prototype by EOD and add a gif. :ok_hand:

Maya: I'll update figma and add alt states for color-blind mode.

Ashok: I'll put together an API sketch and rough migration plan by tomorrow morning.

Loren: Great — thanks all. tagging follow-up: @Maya @Sam @Ashok. :rocket:
